description: Use when the watch stopped and restarted and one workout is in 2 to 5 files. Orders the pieces by time, checks they follow each other, proposes trimming a piece that overlaps the one before (the join depends on it), and proposes one join; one recording lying inside another is refused (try analyze_dual_recording). Pieces of different sports export as one multisport file. Nothing is changed by this call, and nothing that alters heart rate or any other data is applied without the user's confirmation. Show the user every step whose needsUserConfirmation is true, with its title, reason and changes, and get an explicit yes; then call apply_plan with exactly the confirmed step ids. Relay findings and notes in plain words. If refusal is set, tell the user why and do not offer a workaround the answer does not give.

activityIds.description: The 2 to 5 pieces of one workout, in any order.

name: analyze_interrupted_workout
